We need to review candidate.py against spec. Spec: implement append_batch(store, values). Both arguments are lists of integers. Accept only non-negative values. If any value is negative, raise ValueError and leave store exactly unchanged; otherwise append all values in order. Validation and mutation are single-threaded.

Candidate implementation: loops over values, if value >= 0: store.append(value); else raise ValueError. This means when encountering a negative value, it raises ValueError after having already appended any prior non-negative values. That violates the contract: store must remain unchanged if any negative value. So bug.
